ambiguities.decision: Karesmine and Karamine resolve contextually to Karsemine within this encounter. S23 alternates Karsemine/Karesmine in the same combat, corroborating variation. No global alias merge request.
S25 supports refugee/warehouse/children context, but does not individually identify rescued children. Exact membership stays operator addition alongside medium-confidence contextual inference.

Warehouse pair, local flesh mass, historical Edge flesh mass and bayou tentacles are separate scopes. Similarity does not establish same individual. Created town attackers are broad group; exact warehouse pair derivation unproved.
World seed text names Threnn. No exact identity proof inspected; do not merge Thrin with Threnn or assert hijack mechanics as played events.

150 years dates fort era, not creature arrival. No movement/no threat/pull gone/city okay are time-local. Plans do not prove execution. Long rest is proposed then later daylight, not explicit duration.

Hesta and Grobnok literal names retained; Lestra/Gruknok unsupported. Alchamist’s Fire occurs in same supply/fire context as Alchemist’s Fire; item variant resolved locally, not alternate person. WitnessSeed compact spelling is search convenience, source uses Witness Seed.

Current house/warehouse/Inn/defense/rebuilding = Mireward; Brin history and Fellinor bank/assets = Edge; Cinderbranch city = Mirathorn. No evidence for Pippa/Bubbles town. Road to Fin and north road remain separate.
All graph IDs are gold-local. No accepted World queried; native identity bindings remain proposals requiring separate proof.

Children, pair, responders, refugees and town attackers are scoped groups. Two monsters carry plural children, exact child count not stated. S25 55 arrivals differs from earlier approximate fifty; preserve chronology rather than force equality.

Post-burning monsters stop as if direction lost. Psychic control is contextual explanation, not directly proved telepathic mechanism. Cure production is not proof all refugees consumed cure. Seed lifelong call not proved identical to local pull.
